plugins.name: shopping-agent
plugins.description: Searches Amazon.in and Flipkart through a real browser, filters listings by per-site rating and review-count rules, and builds a ranked HTML catalog.

plugins.name: yt-insights
plugins.description: YouTube channel analytics and upload tooling: ranked HTML report with retention curves and experiment tracking from the Data and Analytics APIs, Studio CSV merge, title/description/captions/music drafting in the channel's own voice, exact 9:16 Shorts thumbnails with photo cutouts, and an opt-in publish skill that sets a thumbnail, metadata or captions on an uploaded video through a separate write token.

plugins.name: ai-catchup
plugins.description: Finds what changed recently across Claude, Claude Code, OpenAI and Gemini, explains one thing at a time with sources, and keeps one markdown note per topic so nothing is re-explained twice. Runs on demand or unattended on a daily schedule, emailing the full note plus a cost and token report.

plugins.name: higgsfield-video
plugins.description: Turns a theme and an idea into a fact-checked multi-shot video brief for Kling 3.0 on Higgsfield: per-shot prompts inside the Custom limits (3 s minimum, 5 shots, 15 s, chip character budget), Elements and voice tags per shot, a validator, and a pre-Generate checklist. API generation scaffolded.

plugins.name: football-shorts
plugins.description: Research this week's viral football moments with verified sources, build a 9:16 Short from them with ffmpeg + Pillow, enhance a video you already have (hooks, counters, slow-mo, punch-ins, synthesised SFX, blurred-fill layout), and revise from numbered feedback.

plugins.name: football-stories
plugins.description: Narrated football story Shorts with no footage: verified story cards with two sources per fact (legwork on a Sonnet subagent), a fact-cited script, free or paid narration (Gemini TTS en-IN voices, Kokoro, your own recording) at a slightly slower pace, Whisper word alignment, animated template cards with word-timed captions, and revision from numbered feedback.

plugins.name: gemini-image
plugins.description: Generates or edits one image per request with the Gemini image API, asking where to save every time and never overwriting without asking.

plugins.name: gemini-cost
plugins.description: Checks Google AI Studio / Gemini API usage and billing for a project through the user's signed-in browser: requests and tokens per model, cost before and after credits, Developer Program credit remaining, prepaid balance, and rate-limit tier. Read-only, no API key or stored credential of any kind.
